title: Vickers Wellington LP841 - Tablet
memorial_details: Plain, rectangular tablet, possibly limestone. Commemoration is incised in capital letters. A RAF and A RCAF crest are incised in the top left and right corners respectively.
inscription: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE 4 CREW/ AND THE ONE SURVIVOR/ WHEN WELLINGTON LP481 OF/ 82 O.T.U. OSSINGTON CRASHED IN THE SOUTH/ FIELD LAXTON ON 5TH JANUARY 1945/ (names)
community_connection: The memorial is cared for by St Nichael the Archangel Church.
